events.title: Indian Shares Seen Higher At Open
events.description: Indian shares look set to open higher on Wednesday after reports suggested that a new peace proposal put forward by Qatar and Pakistan has received positive responses from Washington and Tehran, raising hopes that a breakthrough to halt the war could be announced possibly this week.

events.title: Thai Shares Due For Support On Wednesday
events.description: The Thai stock market has finished lower in three straight sessions, sinking more than 20 points or 1.4 percent in that span. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,550-point plateau although it may stop the bleeding on Wednesday.

events.title: Japanese Market Significantly Higher
events.description: The Japanese stock market is trading significantly higher on Wednesday, reversing some of the losses in the previous two sessions, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is moving above the 64,700 level, with gains in exporters, financial and technology stocks partially offset by weakness in automaker stocks.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market May Extend Tuesday's Gains
events.description: The Indonesia stock market on Tuesday ended the three-day losing streak in which it had crashed more than 950 points or 16.6 percent. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 5,275-point plateau and it has a positive lead again for Wednesday's trade.

events.title: Hong Kong Stock Market Poised To Open To The Upside On Wednesday
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market headed south again on Tuesday, one session after ending the two-day slide in which it had dropped more than 280 points or 1.2 percent. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 23,860-point plateau although it may bounce higher again on Wednesday.

events.title: Australian Market Slightly Lower
events.description: Australian shares are trading slightly lower on Wednesday after opening in the green, extending the losses in the previous session, with the benchmark S&P/ASX 200 falling to near the 8,800 level, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight, with a mixed performance across most sectors.

events.title: Win Streak May Continue For China Stock Market
events.description: The China stock market has finished higher in three straight sessions, gathering almost 30 points or 0.8 percent in that span. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just above the 3,735-point plateau and it's expected to open to the upside again on Wednesday.

events.title: Higher Open Called For Taiwan Stock Market
events.description: The Taiwan stock market has finished lower in consecutive trading days, declining almost 820 points or 1.7 percent along the way. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 46,290-point plateau although it may find support on Wednesday.

events.title: Singapore Stock Market May See Support At 5,400 Points
events.description: The Singapore stock market has finished lower in two straight sessions, dropping more than 10 points or 0.2 percent along the way. The STI now sits just above the 5,400-point plateau although it figures to rebound on Wednesday.

events.title: Japan September Trade Shortfall Y536.6 Billion
events.description: Japan posted a merchandise trade deficit of 536.6 billion yen in September, the Ministry of Finance said on Wednesday.

events.title: Malaysia Stock Market May Tick Higher Again On Wednesday
events.description: The Malaysia stock market on Tuesday ended the three-day slide in which it had slumped more than 30 points or 2 percent. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just shy of the 1,600-point plateau and it may add to its winnings on Wednesday.

events.title: Japan Stock Market May Stop The Bleeding On Wednesday
events.description: The Japan stock market has finished lower in back-to-back sessions, stumbling almost 1,300 points or 2 percent along the way. The Nikkei now sits just above the 64,075-point plateau although it may find support on Wednesday.

events.title: Oversold KOSPI May Rebound On Wednesday
events.description: The South Korea stock market on Tuesday halted the two-day winning streak in which it had rallied more than 210 points or 3.6 percent. The KOSPI now sits just above the 5,550-point plateau
